assertions.claim: Don't induce vomiting after swallowing cleaner/pesticide/medicine — the caustic liquid burns the esophagus again on the way up.
assertions.cn_span: 误服清洁剂、农药、药物不要催吐——腐蚀性液体吐出来会把食管再烧一遍

assertions.claim: First drink a moderate amount of milk or egg white, take packaging and instructions to the doctor.
assertions.cn_span: 先喝适量牛奶或蛋清，带上瓶子和说明书立刻就医

assertions.claim: Skin or eyes: flush with plenty of clean water for 15 minutes; eyes with lids pulled apart, never rub.
assertions.cn_span: 用大量清水冲够 15 分钟，眼睛要撑开眼皮冲、不要揉

assertions.claim: Disinfectant mixed with toilet cleaner produces chlorine gas — can go wrong on the spot.
assertions.cn_span: 消毒液和洁厕剂混着用会产生氯气，当场就能出事

assertions.claim: Hazardous products identified by pH (<3 and >11 categories) — reproduced in RU Эффект.
assertions.cn_span: 高危产品按 pH 认：pH<3 的是洁厕剂、除垢剂…pH>11 的是管道疏通剂、厨房强力除污剂…

assertions.claim: Store out of children's reach or locked, never pour into beverage bottles; if unsure what was swallowed, take the bottle, instructions and vomit along.
assertions.cn_span: 把清洁剂、消毒液、农药和药品放到孩子够不着的高处或者带锁的柜子里，绝不分装进饮料瓶
